notes: Stage DAG of `jjv run episode` for the LIVE-ACTION domain, chosen from the episode's `domain` by engine/run/dag.py (recipe_for_domain): this file lists its domain; no engine source names it. Same walker, same placeholders, same stop rules as episode-dag-v001.json (see its notes).

Order follows docs/plans/2026-10-30-newtecons-10lan/AUDIT-AUTO-NEWTECONS-v001.md: ingest -> storyboard -> library (human) -> images/native anchor -> voice -> video plan/prompt -> H3 qualification gate -> h3 inputs -> video render (GPU, per-shot scheduler) -> 1080p gate -> publish-shots -> timing -> music -> editorial -> mix -> review cut -> qa -> user review -> master -> deliver -> brand -> publish. storyboard and music are extra stages because editorial boundaries and the mix need their receipts; qa runs BEFORE the human review, as in the cartoon recipe.

Gate kind `receipt-gate` (engine/run/gates.py): holds only while the recipe-named file/glob exists. Used for the library approval, the H3 qualification and the 1080p gate; it never writes or infers anything.

GPU: every `gpu` step stops without --approve-gpu AND a signed scoped GPU proof (--gpu-proof FILE; recipe gpu_authorization: proof); a bare flag is a request. Human decisions need a signed human proof (human_proof: required). Proofs are a file-token speed bump (engine/run/proof.py), not an unforgeable signature. `video run --gpu-approved` still uses the verb's own approval file {runs_root}/approvals/gpu-approved.json.

Known unwired pieces (audit): B02 episode wiring (files.script, cast, library_dir, shot_pack, master_config), B08 H3 qualification, B10/B11 faces and carry, B12/B14 1080p adapter + exporter, B17 no film-2k. Each is a named STOP or a known_gap, never silently skipped.
Fixed --out folders: deliver, brand and publish refuse an existing output directory (`fresh`); move the stage folder aside before a second real run.

Stage `images` was split (SPEC-DAG-FIX): library -> layout-plan -> layout-author -> layout-check -> layout-render -> still-route-check -> still-assets -> still-set-control -> still-lock -> still-nine -> still-fix -> still-review -> images-native. still-set-control keeps checkpoints 03/05 (disabled, missing weights) and 04 (blocked) visible.

health_gate.todo: T-E39 engine-level health preflight (docker engine, container identity + --disable-partner-nodes, ComfyUI HTTP, idle queue, free VRAM, graph nodes). Since M8-f1 `bin/jjv.py` registers `health`, and the orchestrator runs `argv` as a gate right before EVERY gpu step (voice synth, every layout render, every images submit, h3 submit, seedvr2 execute). When the module or its verb is missing the run records `health_gate: not-available` and every gpu step STOPS (nothing runs unchecked).

stages.label: contract + config

steps.note: read-only: exit 1 when DELIVERY-CONTRACT.json is stale; lock it with `jjv config contract --write`

stages.label: script ingest (jjv/script/v1 -> shots, cast bindings, dialogue, boundaries input)
storyboard plan + continuity check
character library: every character x kind x slot approved + cast bound (human proof)
stages.known_gap: the 8x20 library is queue/account-driven (`jjv images library plan|run`) and is NOT run by this recipe. The gate recomputes coverage from episode.files.library_requirements (explicit characters x kinds x slots) and episode.files.library_dir; one approval file, a missing slot, a duplicate revision or a cast canonical that is not an approved pick STOPs. The requirement manifest is not signed (a person who can edit it can lower the policy); shot-role mapping vs script.character_references is not checked here.

stages.label: layout plan: set + draft briefs (CPU)
stages.known_gap: scaffold only: briefs are drafts until the layout-author stage.

stages.label: layout author: a person fills set/camera/placement (draft never counts)
stages.known_gap: `layout plan` writes filled:false drafts; no engine verb records that a layout is authored, so this is a named STOP on a receipt a person/verb writes. Existence of the file is a speed bump; the real check is layout-check (no --allow-draft).

receipt-gate.label: LAYOUT_DRAFT: layout-authored
receipt-gate.next: fill set.json and briefs/*.json in the layout-plan folder, then write layout-authored.json beside them and re-run --from layout-author

stages.label: layout check (no --allow-draft)
stages.known_gap: `layout check` prints its verdict to stdout only (no --out): a hash-bound layout-check.json adapter is missing; a failing check still STOPs by exit code.

stages.label: layout render per shot: beauty+depth+mask (GPU)
stages.known_gap: carry (non-cut) shots and a render-receipt reuse check are not modelled; each real run writes new takes (never overwritten).

stages.label: still route check: node/model/graph readiness per shot
stages.known_gap: no route manifest writer exists yet; missing weights/adapters must STOP, never switch provider silently.

receipt-gate.label: still-route-check
receipt-gate.next: write the hash-bound still-route.json after the readiness check, then re-run --from still-route-check

stages.label: 02 ASSET 4 GOC: front/back/left/right per asset
stages.known_gap: four angles with output/ref/approval/hash each; one collage is not four assets; no adapter yet.

receipt-gate.label: still-assets
receipt-gate.next: produce and approve the four angles, record still-assets.json

stages.label: 03 3D Trellis: tat, thieu weights | 04 SET 3D 3x3: blocked by 03 + no GLB bridge | 05 ControlNet pose+depth: tat, thieu weights
stages.known_gap: checkpoints 03/05 are disabled (missing weights) and 04 is blocked; they stay visible blockers, never completed. A signed reference-2d profile (not given) would be the only way to proceed without them.

receipt-gate.label: still-set-control: 03 off (weights), 04 blocked, 05 off (weights)
receipt-gate.next: install the weights/bridge with a readiness receipt, or get a signed reference-2d profile

stages.label: 06 KHOA ASSET: pin refs and prove the graph uses them
stages.known_gap: identity/wardrobe lock needs a qualified route; a ref-hash receipt alone is not a QA pass.

receipt-gate.label: still-lock
receipt-gate.next: pin the refs, run the qualified lock graph, record still-lock.json

stages.known_gap: B08: without this receipt `h3 inputs`/`prepare`/`submit` refuse for the domain; a person must authorise the pilot, --approve-gpu does not replace it.

receipt-gate.label: h3-not-qualified

stages.known_gap: B10/B11: one face port per route (speaker and listener of different characters) and carry shots across revisions are not wired; this step builds revision r001 only. The manifest is write-once (identical bytes reused, different bytes refused by the verb).

stages.label: video render per shot (GPU): H3 prepare/submit/adopt inside the per-shot scheduler
stages.known_gap: `jjv video run --completion` walks the shots itself (one GPU job at a time) and returns exit 0 at the user's pick gate; the stage then lacks its render receipts and the run stops there by design. The user's approval for THIS render is the receipt {runs_root}/approvals/gpu-approved.json, passed as --gpu-approved only when it exists.

stages.label: 1080p per shot: gate 'needs-gpu-pilot-approval' until an adapter exists

receipt-gate.label: needs-gpu-pilot-approval
receipt-gate.next: a person authorises a GPU pilot of a 1080p backend AND an adapter is registered in engine/video/upscale.py (REGISTRY is empty today: a receipt alone is not enough), pin the qualification receipt, then pick each shot with `jjv video accept --pick`
